evaluation_system_002.answer: Minneapolis Standards of Effective Instruction (SOEI) / MPS Standards of Effective Instruction (Domains & Rubrics)
evaluation_system_002.evidence: Purpose and Scope: The Minneapolis Standards of Effective Instruction were designed for the primary purpose of ensuring teaching quality and student achievement.

evaluation_ratings_005.evidence: The rubric has four descriptors used with each domain defining levels of effectiveness: Requires Attention, Developing, Proficient, or Exemplary
